If we, it ended up not doing it on the thirtieth then we moved it to the second then the price would be a little bit lower for the second.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: We don't take us no rest and securing a spot as well ... once you're ready to go ahead with the booking. top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details systematically—addresses, floor levels, elevator access, walking distances, furniture specifics, and box count—before moving to pricing, and delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with clear terms early in the call.
coaching_note: Step 7 needs a direct, unsoftened ask ('Would you like our help with your move?') preceded by explicit rate-lock and no-deposit language; also missing Step 6 entirely—return to genuine final concerns check ('What's still concerning you about this move?') before closing.
